text: find this bug: outliners will hold a name, and somehow can be renamed to Part 1  Part 2 .....
resolution: Diagnosed the outliner name reset against the live Compact Car session and the persisted runtime event log. Ctrl+Z twice restored native geometry with two part ranges while its journal metadata note contained only one outliner row; AppFrame rejected that stale note, entered geometry reconciliation, failed to preserve either authored row because preservation requires an exact old [lo,hi) match, and the unnamed imported mesh had no semantic region name to recover. The explicit fallback then minted Part 1 / Part 2 and part:rebuild identities. The state-authority defect is that part metadata reaches the native journal asynchronously through a React effect, so a structural snapshot can capture a stale row count; the recovery path compounds it by treating range coordinates as identity and discarding valid names. No source fix was applied because this request asked to find and explain the bug.
